faq.title: MAYA CAN HELP
faq.copy: Ask anything about tipping, accounts, streaming, payments, privacy, or how the platform works.
faq.site.a:
XMASKEDFREAKS is a video-first entertainment platform. The main experience centers around the live-style video room, where you can watch the stream, use chat, send tips, open games, check your wallet, and ask Maya for help without leaving the page.

The stream may be delivered through OBS or another approved video provider. Some programming may be prerecorded and presented in a live-room format, while chat, tipping, goals, games, notifications, and account activity continue updating around the video experience.

You can browse the available sections using the main navigation. The Live tab takes you to the stream, the Games tab contains the available arcade games, and the wallet area shows your current balance and coin total.

You do not have to use every feature. You can simply watch, or you can choose to participate through tipping, chat, games, and other available tools.
faq.wallet.a:
Wallet deposits allow you to add platform coins to your account. Choose an available coin package or an exact supported amount, review the price and the number of coins you will receive, and continue through the secure payment-processor checkout.

Your wallet should be credited only after the payment processor confirms that the transaction was successful. A pending, canceled, declined, or incomplete payment should not add coins to your account.

Your wallet keeps a record of approved deposits, coin purchases, and eligible spending activity. Coin balances may update automatically after confirmation, but you may occasionally need to refresh the page if the processor is still completing the transaction.

Platform coins are digital credits for use on this website. They are not a bank balance, cannot be withdrawn as cash, and cannot be transferred outside the platform.
faq.tips.a:
Tips let you support the stream using coins already available in your wallet or through another approved payment method offered by the platform.

You choose the amount you are comfortable sending. Smaller tips are allowed when supported by the payment processor, and you are not required to purchase a $25 coin package before sending a live tip.

Before the tip is completed, the site should show the amount, the number of coins involved, and the recipient. Review that information carefully before confirming.

After a wallet-funded tip is approved, the selected coins are deducted from your wallet and added to the stream’s tip activity or Daily Goal where applicable. Direct card tips should be counted only after the processor confirms payment.

Tips are voluntary. Maya may explain or confirm your selection, but Maya should never automatically increase your tip or pressure you into choosing a larger amount.
faq.coinUsage.a:
Platform coins are digital credits used inside XMASKEDFREAKS. They may be used for eligible features such as tipping during streams, participating in supported platform activities, or purchasing eligible digital items or merchandise when those options are available.

Coins cannot be exchanged for cash, withdrawn to a bank account, transferred to another platform, or sent outside the website.

Your coin balance is tied to your account. Protect your login information because activity completed through your account may affect your balance.

The number of coins received from a purchase, including any bonus coins, should always be shown before checkout. Bonus amounts may vary by package and promotion.
faq.refunds.a:
Tips and completed digital-entertainment purchases are generally final once the tip is sent, access is granted, or playback begins.

Because tips are voluntary digital transactions, a change of mind after confirmation normally does not qualify for a refund.

However, duplicate charges, verified billing errors, unauthorized account activity, or clear technical failures may be reviewed by support. Approval is not automatic and depends on the transaction details and applicable payment rules.

When contacting support, provide the receipt email, transaction date, amount, and processor transaction or receipt ID when available. Never send full card numbers, security codes, or passwords.
faq.live.a:
The platform is built around a live-room experience, but some video programming may be prerecorded and streamed through OBS or another approved provider.

Even when the video itself is prerecorded, surrounding platform features may continue functioning in real time. These can include chat, tipping, wallet updates, Daily Goal progress, games, notifications, moderation, and support.

The platform should clearly disclose when prerecorded entertainment is being used. Do not assume that every visible action in the video is happening at the exact moment you are watching.

Maya can help explain the current stream format, but Maya should not falsely claim that prerecorded footage is occurring live.
faq.account.q: Why do I need an account?
faq.account.a:
An account helps the platform securely connect your activity to one profile.

Your account may be used to maintain your wallet balance, coin-purchase history, tip history, saved preferences, game scores, support requests, access controls, and approved payment-method references.

Accounts also make it easier to protect your balance, review transactions, recover access, manage privacy settings, and enforce age or safety restrictions.

You should use accurate contact information and protect your password. Do not share your account or allow another person to make purchases through it without permission.

Some public areas may be viewable without an account, but wallet, tipping, saved history, and personalized features may require sign-in.
faq.tech.q: What if the video is lagging?
faq.tech.a:
If the video is buffering, freezing, or falling behind, first wait a few seconds to see whether playback recovers automatically.

If the problem continues:

1. Refresh the page once.
2. Check that your internet connection is stable.
3. Close unnecessary downloads, streams, or browser tabs.
4. Confirm that your browser is updated.
5. Try reducing video quality if a quality control is available.
6. Disable a VPN temporarily if it is causing connection problems.
7. Try another supported browser or device.

Refreshing the video should not intentionally erase your wallet balance, completed tips, or saved account history.

Nova may help identify playback problems, while Katy may monitor network quality and bandwidth-related alerts for the administrator. If the issue continues, contact support and include your device, browser, approximate time, and a description of what happened.
faq.privacy.a:
The platform should collect and store only the information reasonably needed for account access, age and safety controls, payments, fraud prevention, customer support, analytics, moderation, and operation of the website.

Payment-card information should be handled through the approved payment processor. The platform should not directly store full card numbers or CVV security codes.

Account and transaction records may include information such as your email address, payment status, wallet activity, tip history, support messages, login security information, and limited technical data used for fraud prevention or analytics.

The platform should not sell your private account information. Access to sensitive administrative information must be limited by role and permission.

You can review the Privacy Policy for more details about collected information, retention, processor involvement, security practices, and available privacy choices.
faq.maya.a:
Maya is the platform’s quiet customer-support assistant. Maya is designed to help with common questions about tipping, wallet balances, coin packages, playback, account access, site navigation, policies, games, and basic troubleshooting.

Maya may explain a selected purchase or tip before you confirm it, but Maya should not complete a payment without your explicit approval, change the amount you selected, or pressure you into spending more.

Maya is not a bank, payment processor, attorney, emergency service, or replacement for a human support representative.

For sensitive billing disputes, suspected unauthorized activity, account-recovery problems, or issues Maya cannot resolve, Maya should direct you to the appropriate human-support path.
faq.support.copy: Ask Maya anything or use the available support links for tutorials, account help, billing information, platform rules, and technical assistance.
